intro: The Salmon + Strawberry Sesame Bowl from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) combines glazed salmon with fresh greens, feta, and a sweet-tangy strawberry sesame dressing. This premium bowl delivers 36g of protein and 700 calories, offering a perfect balance of Mediterranean flavors with a fruity twist. Available at CAVA locations nationwide, this signature bowl showcases quality ingredients in every bite.
priceCalories: Priced at $16.95 to $18.45 depending on location, the Salmon + Strawberry Sesame Bowl contains 700 calories with 36g protein, 46g carbs, and 43g fat. This makes it one of the higher-protein options on the [full CAVA menu](/). The price reflects the premium glazed salmon portion, delivering excellent nutritional value for those seeking a protein-rich, satisfying meal.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this bowl apart is the unique strawberry sesame dressing that pairs beautifully with glazed salmon. The combination of super greens, romaine, crumbled feta, pickled onions, and fire-roasted corn creates layers of texture and flavor. This curated bowl offers a restaurant-quality experience with Mediterranean ingredients and an unexpected fruit-forward dressing that elevates the entire dish.
nutritionFacts: With 700 calories, this bowl provides 36g of protein from omega-3-rich salmon and feta cheese. The 46g of carbs come from vegetables and corn, while 43g of fat includes healthy fats from salmon and dressing. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for detailed macros. This balanced profile supports muscle maintenance and sustained energy throughout your day.
whatsInside: The bowl features glazed salmon as the protein base, layered over super greens and romaine lettuce. Crumbled feta adds Mediterranean saltiness, while pickled onions provide tang and fire-roasted corn brings sweetness. The strawberry sesame dressing ties everything together with its unique fruity-nutty profile. Every ingredient from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) and [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) works in harmony.
tasteLike: Expect a delightful contrast of savory glazed salmon with sweet-tart strawberry sesame dressing. The feta delivers salty creaminess while pickled onions add brightness and crunch. Fire-roasted corn provides smoky sweetness, and the mixed greens offer fresh, crisp texture. The strawberry dressing creates an unexpected but delicious pairing that balances rich salmon with fruity acidity.
customize: Customize your bowl by swapping to options from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) like brown rice or black lentils. Add extra protein or switch to chicken for a lighter option. Explore [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) to add hummus or tzatziki. Adjust toppings or try different options from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) to create your perfect combination.
pairsWell: This bowl pairs excellently with a side of pita chips or a seasonal dessert from the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts). The fruity dressing complements sparkling beverages or lemonade from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks). For a complete meal, add a side of hummus or crazy feta to enjoy with your bowl for extra Mediterranean flavors.
healthyChoice: With 36g of protein and omega-3 fatty acids from salmon, this bowl supports heart health and muscle recovery. The super greens and romaine provide vitamins and fiber, while the balanced macros keep you satisfied. Though higher in calories at 700, the nutrient density makes it worthwhile for active individuals. Visit [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for dietary information.
howToOrder: Order the Salmon + Strawberry Sesame Bowl at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by asking for it by name from the curated bowls section. You can also customize it when ordering online or through the CAVA app. Request modifications like extra salmon or additional toppings to suit your preferences. The bowl comes pre-designed but staff will accommodate reasonable adjustments.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Chicken + Rice Bowl at 700 calories and lower price, this offers premium salmon protein. The Greek Salad Bowl provides fewer calories at 580 but less protein. The Harissa Avocado Bowl and Falafel Crunch Bowl offer higher calories with plant-based options. This salmon bowl delivers the best protein-to-calorie ratio among premium [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) selections.
whoShouldTry: Perfect for seafood lovers seeking a protein-rich Mediterranean meal with unique flavor combinations. Fitness enthusiasts will appreciate the 36g protein and balanced macros. Those who enjoy sweet-savory pairings will love the strawberry sesame dressing with salmon. Anyone exploring the [full CAVA menu](/) should try this signature bowl for a memorable dining experience.
worthTrying: The Salmon + Strawberry Sesame Bowl absolutely deserves a try for its innovative flavor pairing and quality ingredients. At $16.95-$18.45, you receive premium glazed salmon with restaurant-quality presentation and nutrition. The unique strawberry sesame dressing alone makes this worth ordering. Whether you are a CAVA regular or first-timer, this bowl showcases what makes CAVA special.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Salmon + Strawberry Sesame Bowl?
faqs.a: The Salmon + Strawberry Sesame Bowl contains 700 calories with 36g protein, 46g carbs, and 43g fat. This makes it a balanced, protein-rich option on the CAVA menu.

faqs.q: How much does the Salmon + Strawberry Sesame Bowl cost?
faqs.a: The bowl is priced between $16.95 and $18.45 depending on your location. This premium pricing reflects the quality glazed salmon and curated ingredient selection.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in the Salmon + Strawberry Sesame Bowl?
faqs.a: It includes glazed salmon, super greens, romaine, crumbled feta, pickled onions, fire-roasted corn, and strawberry sesame dressing. All ingredients are fresh and carefully selected for flavor balance.

faqs.q: Is the Salmon + Strawberry Sesame Bowl gluten free?
faqs.a: The bowl itself may be gluten free, but verify with staff about the glazed salmon preparation and dressing. Check the CAVA Gluten Free Menu or ask at your location for confirmation.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Salmon + Strawberry Sesame Bowl?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize by changing the base, adding extra toppings, swapping proteins, or choosing different dressings. CAVA encourages personalization to match your dietary preferences and taste.
